title: Log in
lead: You log in with your Discord account. We never ask for a password or an email address.
reauth: Your session has expired. For your security, please log in again.
footnote: Discord only shares your name and your list of servers. You can manage the servers where you have the Administrator or Manage Server permission.

errors.AccessDenied: You cancelled the authorisation on Discord. Try again if you’ve changed your mind.
errors.OAuthCallbackError: Discord didn’t confirm the login. Please try again.
errors.OAuthSignin: Couldn’t start the Discord login. Please try again.
errors.Configuration: Login is currently unavailable (configuration error). Please let the operator know.
errors.Verification: The login link has expired. Please start again.
errors.Captcha_missing: Confirm that you’re not a robot (captcha), then log in.
errors.Captcha_invalid: The captcha check failed — please try again.
errors.Captcha_unavailable: The captcha service is currently unavailable — try again in a minute.
errors.Captcha_unconfigured: Login is currently unavailable (the captcha isn’t configured). Please let the operator know.
